hyperedge_rule: one hyperedge per OpenAlex CS work; members are its authors

filters.derived_from: openalex_cs (the same pipeline before the size-3 cut)
filters.derivation_rule: keep hyperedges with size >= 3; drop resulting zero-degree nodes; remap node/hyperedge ids

known_limitations: E = one hyperedge per work, containing the work's authors (after author-level filtering).
X = author x topic counts (OpenAlex topic IDs), L1 row-normalized.
Topic IDs are NOT field/subfield: they are the leaf-level topic IDs from work.topics[].
A.country = most frequent affiliation country across the author's works in this sample.
A.institution_type = most frequent affiliation type across the author's works.
A.career_stage = bucketed earliest observed publication year IN THIS SAMPLE; true first publication year is unknown, so this is an OBSERVED-CAREER-STAGE PROXY.
Y.dominant_label = most frequent OpenAlex field (level 1) across the author's works.
Hyperedges are real coauthor groups; KNN / label-based hyperedges are NOT used.
Country / institution_type / career_stage / author_id are NOT used as features.
Derived from `openalex_cs` by keeping hyperedges with size >= 3 and dropping resulting isolated nodes.
